lines.trans: Ladies and gentlemen, we are starting the final round!
Without any doubts, I give my vote...
I give my vote, of course, to Oksana.
And I give my vote to Viktor.
Dmitry Vladimirovich, now your word is decisive.
Both dishes turned out simply delicious.

words.gloss: to turn out, to work out

lines.trans: Vitya, I have known you for a very long time.

words.gloss: for a long time; long ago

lines.trans: But I truly got to know you only today.
I did not think that the choice would be so difficult.
I am making the choice not with my mind and not with my stomach.
I am making this difficult choice with my heart.
The winner of our show today becomes Oksana!

examples.text: Победителем нашего шоу сегодня становится Оксана!
examples.trans: The winner of our show today becomes Oksana!

examples.text: Аплодисменты нашему победителю!
examples.trans: Applause for our winner!

meanings.note: Russian determiner/pronoun ('our') agreeing in gender, number, and case with the noun phrase it specifies.

examples.text: Только один станет шеф-поваром нашего ресторана.
examples.trans: Only one will become the head chef of our restaurant.

examples.text: Победителя выберет наше звёздное жюри.
examples.trans: Our celebrity jury will choose the winner.

examples.text: Давай выпьем за нашу долгую дружбу!
examples.trans: Let's drink to our long friendship!

meanings.note: Declinable neuter noun meaning 'show', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Я Дмитрий Нагиев, это шоу «Шеф-повар».
examples.trans: I am Dmitry Nagiyev, this is the show 'Head Chef'.

examples.text: Мне ещё завтра в шоу выступать.
examples.trans: I still have to perform on the show tomorrow.

examples.text: А мне это шоу завтра вести!
examples.trans: And I have to host that show tomorrow!

становиться.gloss: to become, to get, to grow

meanings.en: to become, to get, to grow
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (root 'тановиться'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to become', forming an aspectual pair with 'стать'.

examples.text: Победителем нашего шоу сегодня становится Оксана!
examples.trans: The winner of our show today becomes Oksana!

examples.text: А ты алкоголиком становишься.
examples.trans: And you are becoming an alcoholic.

examples.text: А ты алкоголиком становишься. Счастливо!
examples.trans: And you are becoming an alcoholic. Goodbye!

meanings.note: Declinable feminine noun meaning 'oksana', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Кажется, это Нагиев и участница Оксана.
examples.trans: It seems that is Nagiyev and the contestant Oksana.

examples.text: Победителем нашего шоу сегодня становится Оксана!
examples.trans: The winner of our show today becomes Oksana!
